name: fmp_commodity_list
description:
Commodities covered by Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), with their symbols.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/commodity-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the symbols with fmp_commodity_quote or fmp_commodity_historical.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
